text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Malta takes up Libya's United Nations sanctions case again. Foreign Minister George Vella, addressing the Non-Aligned movement's foreign ministers' meeting in New Delhi, reiterated Malta's view that sanctions against Libya should not continue, although Malta would continue to respect them while they existed.
- General Workers' Union leaders and Prime Minister Alfred Sant discuss working conditions of government employees.
- Man jailed for 52 months over drug trafficking.

- Opposition leader says government acted against advice of World Health Organisation over decision to build new hospital. The hospital is to have up to 1,000 beds but the WHO says new hospitals should have up to 400 beds only.
